collapsed_comparison.control_cases: actual frozen single-PRN cases with delta_tau=0 and delta_f=0
collapsed_comparison.pairing: for each collapsed case, strong-resolvable injected median at the same dataset and rho_db
collapsed_comparison.pass: 95% paired bootstrap CI lower bound of resolvable-minus-collapsed delta_BIC > 0

controls.awgn: clean reference complex taps plus exactly RMS-normalized deterministic circular complex Gaussian noise; residual RMS from injected target H0; seed=20260818+PRN
controls.gain: clean reference complex taps multiplied by one positive-real complex scalar so tap RMS equals injected observed tap RMS
controls.scope: all frozen single-PRN cases; strong-resolvable cases used for frozen gates
controls.support: same epoch, PRN, taps, CAF grid, and BIC formula as injected case

four_prn.case_success: at least 3 of 4 target PRNs satisfy abs(delay error)<=0.05 chip and abs(Doppler error)<=10 Hz
four_prn.dataset_gate: at least 0.75 of strong-resolvable four-PRN cases succeed
four_prn.prn_dominance: a successful case requires recovery on at least three distinct PRNs, so it cannot be attributed to one PRN

physics_recovery_definition: abs(delay error)<=0.05 chip and abs(Doppler error)<=10 Hz
rms_shortcut_scope: absolute Spearman correlation of target delta_BIC and output interval RMS across all 28 single-PRN cases, separately by dataset
